title: Horned Mechanical Scarecrow
description: A surreal mechanical figure with a rusted metal helmet, large curved horns dripping red liquid, and glowing blue mechanical eyes stands in a dark garden. It has bird-like wings, exposed gears, green ooze on its torso, and holds a staff, surrounded by poppies, blue flowers, butterflies, and a broken sundial under a stormy sky.
